data.title: PP rejects 'entertainocracy' tag, insists unity intact
data.description: People's Party (PP) leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut insists the party remains united despite criticism from former Future Forward Party (FFP) secretary-general Piyabutr Saengkanokkul over what he calls the rise of "entertainocracy" in politics.

data.title: ThaiHealth funding debate heats up
data.description: The government's plan to end ThaiHealth's earmarked alcohol and tobacco tax funding of more than 4 billion baht a year has drawn mixed views over fiscal scrutiny, independence and public health.

data.title: Close the gap in HIV treatment: UN
data.description: The Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/Aids (UNAIDS) has called for governments, communities, businesses and other sectors to work together to close gaps in HIV prevention and treatment across the Asia-Pacific region.

data.title: BJT MP challenges committee boss
data.description: Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) MP Suphachai Jaismut on Wednesday challenged House committee chairman Rangsiman Rome's authority to place allegations against fellow BJT MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap and her husband on the committee's agenda.

data.title: 2 Myanmar women, 1 Chinese held over B200m scam
data.description: Police have arrested a Chinese man and two Myanmar women over an alleged call-centre network accused of defrauding at least seven students of more than 200 million baht.

data.title: Skydivers fly Thai flag in record attempt
data.description: One Flag Thailand has completed its first world-record mission, flying a 4,303-square-foot Thai national flag over Pattaya.

data.title: Court rejects NBTC chief's B20m suit for defamation
data.description: A civil court has dismissed a 20-million-baht lawsuit filed by National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) chairman Dr Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck against four fellow commissioners, ruling their criticisms concerned their official duties and served the public interest.

data.title: Nene to perform at IMF dinner
data.description: Nene Royal, the 16-year-old Thai winner of America's Got Talent, will perform at a state dinner hosted by Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul for 400 global leaders attending the IMF-World Bank meetings at Government House on Oct 14.

data.title: IP-backed financing will drive Thai creative content
data.description: The Creative Economy Agency (Public Organization), or CEA, is shifting its focus towards creative content as a crucial strategic pillar of economic growth across Asean.

data.title: Govt moves to protect meet
data.description: The government has developed a business continuity plan to ensure the 2026 IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings run smoothly, even if heavy rainfall mars the global gathering, said Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas.

data.title: Thaksin appears in court to challenge asset seizure
data.description: Former prime minister Thaksin Shinawatra told a court on Wednesday that the seizure and freezing of his assets to recover a 17.6-billion-baht tax debt were unlawful, arguing that poor coordination between the Revenue Department and the Ministry of Finance had led to him being pursued twice for the same debt.

data.title: Care home that ‘caged’ residents to be shut down
data.description: Health authorities are preparing to shut down an elderly care centre in Kanchanaburi after finding multiple violations, including providing services beyond the scope of its licence, including having caged beds, illegal expansion and admitting mentally ill patients.

data.title: PM Anutin wants water retention areas around Bangkok
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the Department of Public Works and Town & Country Planning to study ways to develop water retention areas around Bangkok in order to prevent future floods.

data.title: Man held for ‘renting’ ID cards to underage clubgoers
data.description: KHON KAEN - Police have arrested a 19-year-old man accused of renting out national ID cards to underage youths seeking entry to entertainment venues in Khon Kaen, charging 100 baht per card.

data.title: Natthaphong says government’s flood response has failed
data.description: People’s Party leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has called on the government to do more to help local administrative bodies recover from the floods, saying the performance so far has not been good.

data.title: Second incinerator key to solving Phuket’s waste problem
data.description: PHUKET - Authorities in this southern island province are seeking a land plot to build a second incinerator to handle a growing amount of garbage.

data.title: Anutin slams Prachin Buri district chief for mishandling flood
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has admonished Prachin Buri's Ban Sang district chief who was abruptly transferred on Wednesday after being accused of resisting cooperation and not making a sufficient effort to help flood victims in the province.

data.title: Western provinces warned of flooding, poor drainage in east
data.description: The government on Wednesday warned of possible flooding in western provinces with forecasts of heavy rain, while explaining high tides are impeding drainage of flood waters from eastern provinces Chachoengsao and Prachin Buri.

data.title: Filipino family crash into temple wall kills 3-year-old son
data.description: SURAT THANI — A three-year-old Filipino boy was killed and three other members of his family were injured after their Mitsubishi Pajero crashed into a temple wall in Ban Ta Khun district early Wednesday morning.

data.title: Armed robbers take nearly B30m from Chinese residents of Chon Buri mansion
data.description: CHON BURI: Three armed robbers held the Chinese occupants of a luxury residence at gunpoint before escaping with cash and assets worth a combined nearly 30 million baht on Tuesday.
